scope: 17 allocated Homeworld industrial/architecture/urban targets; native original production only, outside repository. Not a closure of all354 catalogue targets or the56 global requirements.

productionMethod.referenceUse: Actually opened source PNGs, then concrete textual style brief. No pixels from references were cropped, copied into an output, mirrored, recolored, rescaled or otherwise transformed.
productionMethod.heroApprovalScope: Assistant selected this candidate as direction for the family. No human validation or in-game approval.
productionMethod.style: Angular near-black basalt/gunmetal, worn antique bronze, sparse amber recesses, warm top-left light, whole-object orthographic front/right three-quarter sprites. Tunnels use32degree elevation; other objects roughly25–30degrees. No claim of identical calibrated projection.
productionMethod.canvas: Actual tool-native dimensions are retained per entry; no assumed uniform resolution. All original PNG bytes preserved.
productionMethod.qualityGate: Thresholds2/8 are alpha-noise diagnostics only. Strict48px alpha>0 padding fails17/17 and no admission is inferred from the friendlier threshold.
productionMethod.retryPolicy: At most one retry for a genuine visual defect/grid was allowed; none used. No retries for faint alpha speckle or padding alone.

historicalSourceAudit.meaning: MISSING is a conservative family-matcher absence, not proof that a required concrete file path is absent. Sources specify catalogue functions, not delivery destination filenames.38selectedtargets have no independent target sprite identified in scoped search;2lift targets already have native files. No313existing-candidate targets are mislabeled missing here.
historicalSourceAudit.scope: Read-only sub-audit of40V111 MISSING targets plus1MISSING_ANIMATION, inherited by activeV112 artTargets. The313 EXISTING_NEEDS_VARIANT targets are intentionally excluded.

guide.normalization: No pixel normalization: explicit parent/user instruction preserves untouched native outputs. The guide requirement for context review is still open.

admissionCriteriaStillRequired.requirement: Original independent native PNG/atlas cell, silhouette whole, positive uniform scale, explicit native rectangle/dimensions/pivot, actual alpha and occupied bounds including all margins and edge pixels; do not manufacture missing function by extracting a painted detail. Preserve original bytes and SHA256/provenance.

Keep exact target ID, role/function, provenance category and candidate status. Existing presence, decode, tests or an assistant inspection never grant human artistic validated status. This audit closes no catalogue entry.

Prop isolation screenshot with a real reference Yautja; inspect silhouette, scale, pivot, alpha, orientation and physical ground support. World dimensions are separate from bitmap dimensions and collision footprint.

Inspect in actual district with wide/medium/near screenshots; verify free approach, usage and exit space, depth and ground support. Common props need visual diversity ideally4–8 native variants. A candidate image does not prove integration/gameplay completion.

Verify plot support, facade orientation, reachable entrance, true passage/cabin clearance and both travel directions. Existing lift V82 must be reviewed rather than regenerated merely because of historical MISSING. No route or collision claim arises from an image.
Author left/right views independently where requested; do not rotate, mirror, skew or stretch a PNG to claim a missing native orientation.

An active/energy state needs distinct native painted temporal states with frame rects,pivots,durations,loop contract and actual rendered temporal inspection. A static support, CSS opacity/transform pulse, NPC walking sheet or recolor does not establish an authored native work/energy cycle. Keep pause/reduced-motion/loading failure behavior explicit.

Show the requested animal-care function and accessible working edge at fauna/mount scale. Habitat support is a rock shelf, not cage/enclosure. A stable-harness NPC, beast picture or static mount does not deliver an independent harness/saddle/cage or mount gameplay. Avoid a human stable; mark local invented iconography original.
